noun_definition: Expense row refers to an individual entry representing a shared expense in a report, which should visually indicate selection through a background color when highlighted, similar to how ungrouped expense rows behave.
Grouped report refers to a collection of shared group expenses in a report that can be individually selected by the user.
Background color refers to the visual highlight that should be applied to a selected expense row in a grouped report, similar to how it is applied to a single, ungrouped expense row.
